title: TE Tyler Higbee, Rams reach agreement on two-year deal

sources.title: TE Tyler Higbee, Rams reach agreement on two-year deal
sources.description: The Rams have reached an agreement with tight end Tyler Higbee on a two-year deal worth up to $8 million, according to multiple reports.
